messages: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.

#p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p900014##k, one of the residents. Ugh, do I really have to deal with that guy again...?\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
I checked in on #p900014#, a resident of #m10003000#. They were as blunt as ever, but maybe we've gotten just a tiny bit closer.
name: Asking After Chun Ji
